tests: a post-merge hook turns the release manager's own merge into a working-tree write, and the block now refuses the write that plants it

consumesExternalOutput.program: git merge --ff-only, run for real in a clone whose .git/hooks/post-merge was planted directly; the escalation is asserted by the marker file the hook wrote, not described
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The test refuses to prove anything unless the planted hook actually ran: it asserts the marker is absent before the merge and present after, so a git build that did not run the hook fails the test loudly instead of turning it into a tautology.
